About

About Me

I work where business systems meet network infrastructure. My career started in telecoms and network engineering and grew into ERP consulting, so I can talk to finance teams about their processes and to engineers about their networks.

I have delivered around 20 ERP and digital transformation projects across manufacturing, FMCG, telecoms, distribution and services. I work through the full cycle: discovery, gap analysis, configuration, user testing, go-live and support after launch.

I present regularly to CFOs, Finance Directors and CEOs, and I write documentation that people actually use.

Outside client work, I care about community connectivity. I have helped deploy public Wi-Fi for communities and worked on school internet connectivity proposals.
